justification: Conveyancing data integrity — wrong former council serves wrong DCP controls silently, heritage misclassification misleads user about conservation area status. User-facing report data.

pre_impl.existing_data: SUBURB_TO_FORMER_COUNCIL dict maps suburb names to former council slugs for Inner West DCP setback lookup. heritage_items and heritage_hca lists from portal and PostGIS merged into controls dict for PDF generation.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Text-based suburb matching assumes suburb name uniquely identifies an LGA. Boundary suburbs (Stanmore, Newtown, Camperdown, St Peters) span two LGAs — text matching picks the wrong one 50% of the time for these suburbs.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Applies to all existing and new conveyancing reports. Boundary suburb addresses that previously got wrong DCP data will now get no DCP data (safe direction) or correct DCP data via PostGIS cross-validation.
pre_impl.external_source_error: PostGIS cross-validation wrapped in try/except — falls back to text match on any DB failure. Never crashes the pipeline. Logs the fallback with address context for debugging.
pre_impl.frontend_type: No frontend type changes — response shape unchanged. heritage_items and heritage_hca are existing list[str] fields.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Before fix: wrong DCP controls served silently for boundary suburbs, heritage items miscategorised as conservation areas. After fix: boundary suburbs get correct DCP via PostGIS or no DCP (safe), heritage items stay correctly classified.

functions.name: _validate_former_council_postgis
functions.input: Optional[str] text_slug from detect_former_council, float lat/lng coordinates, str address for suburb extraction, str zone_epi for EPI context
functions.output: Optional[str] validated lga_slug — confirmed by PostGIS geometry, or None if property is not in the expected LGA boundary
functions.if_none: text_slug=None with PostGIS confirming Inner West returns disambiguated slug. text_slug=None with non-IW PostGIS returns None. DB failure returns text_slug unchanged (fallback).

functions.name: detect_former_council
functions.input: str address (full property address), str zone_epi (EPI name from portal layerintersect, may be empty string)
functions.output: Optional[str] lga_slug for dcp_setback_controls — marrickville, leichhardt, ashfield, or other onboarded LGA slug, or None
functions.if_none: Empty zone_epi returns None (LGA not identifiable). Inner West with unmapped boundary suburb returns None (PostGIS resolves later).

functions.name: generate_conveyancing_pdf
functions.input: ConveyancingPdfRequest with address, lat, lng, prop_id, report_id — heritage merge logic at lines 500-512 inside this function
functions.output: dict with report_id, pdf_url, address, lat, lng — heritage merge mutates controls dict before PDF generation
functions.if_none: Empty postgis hca/items lists cause no mutation. Missing heritage keys default to empty list via .get() or []. None in lists not possible (upstream deduplicates).

values.nullable: no — static dict, always populated at module load
values.if_missing: Boundary suburbs (glebe, alexandria, stanmore, newtown, camperdown, st peters, erskineville) removed — detect_former_council returns None, PostGIS resolves via _validate_former_council_postgis

values.nullable: yes — lookup_lga returns lga_name=None when spatial_overlays has no height layer for the location
values.guard_at: services/conveyancing.py:137 — postgis_lga and postgis_lga != 'inner west' (falsy empty string prevents false override)
values.if_missing: None or empty postgis_lga means PostGIS cannot validate — text match passes through unchanged, no override

values.nullable: yes — controls may not have these keys if portal returned no heritage data
values.if_missing: Missing keys default to empty list via or []. PostGIS data populates from scratch. No crash, no wrong merge.

queries.purpose: PostGIS LGA boundary lookup via spatial_overlays height layer to validate which LGA contains the property coordinates
queries.if_zero: Returns lga_name=None, lga_slug=None — _validate_former_council_postgis falls back to text match
queries.if_wrong: Wrong LGA name would cause wrong override — mitigated by checking postgis_lga against known values ('inner west')

break_it.scenario: Stanmore property on the City of Sydney side gets wrong Marrickville DCP controls because text matching resolves 'stanmore' to 'marrickville'
break_it.what_happens: User sees Marrickville precinct DCP setback controls for a property that is in City of Sydney — completely wrong planning controls applied
break_it.how: scripts/generate_conveyancing_report.py:237 — 'stanmore' removed from SUBURB_TO_FORMER_COUNCIL. services/conveyancing.py:97 — PostGIS cross-validation confirms LGA boundary.

break_it.scenario: Glebe property mapped to Marrickville former council because 'glebe' was in SUBURB_TO_FORMER_COUNCIL — Glebe is entirely in City of Sydney
break_it.what_happens: User sees Inner West DCP setback controls for a City of Sydney property — wrong controls, wrong council, wrong planning framework
break_it.how: scripts/generate_conveyancing_report.py:237 — 'glebe' removed from SUBURB_TO_FORMER_COUNCIL. services/lga_lookup.py:42 — 'glebe' not in _IW_SUBURB_TO_FORMER either.

break_it.scenario: Portal heritage item like 'Item I123' reclassified as Heritage Conservation Area when PostGIS also finds HCA on the same lot
break_it.what_happens: PDF report shows the individual heritage item as a Conservation Area — misleads user about heritage constraints and may trigger wrong compliance requirements
break_it.how: services/conveyancing.py:500-512 — heritage merge now keeps HCA and items separate. PostGIS HCA goes to heritage_hca only. Portal items never reclassified.

break_it.scenario: PostGIS database unreachable during LGA cross-validation — wrong text-matched former council passes through to DCP lookup
break_it.what_happens: Boundary suburb property gets wrong DCP controls because PostGIS fallback trusts the text match that was the source of the bug
break_it.how: services/conveyancing.py:126 — falls back to text_slug on DB error. For unambiguous suburbs this is correct. For removed boundary suburbs text_slug is None so fallback is safe.

break_it.scenario: Newtown property on the Inner West side gets no DCP data because 'newtown' was removed from text mapping and PostGIS returns undisambiguated 'inner_west' slug
break_it.what_happens: User sees 'DCP data unavailable' when DCP data does exist for the Marrickville precinct — false negative, but safe direction (no wrong data served)
break_it.how: services/lga_lookup.py:42 — _IW_SUBURB_TO_FORMER retains boundary suburbs for PostGIS-validated path. lookup_lga disambiguates 'newtown' → 'marrickville' after confirming Inner West via geometry.

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes — run conveyancing report for a Glebe address and a Stanmore address to confirm no wrong DCP data is served
